KXNBAGAME.polymarket: This market will settle to the winner of the <TEAMS> vs <TEAMS> professional basketball game originally scheduled for <DATE> at <TIME>. Overtime is included if played. If the game is delayed, postponed, suspended, or otherwise rescheduled and is not rescheduled to start within two calendar days of the originally scheduled date and time, the market will settle to the last fair market price. Outcome sourced from the relevant governing body.
KXNBAGAME.note: Postponement windows match (Kalshi 48h; Polymarket two calendar days). If never played, each venue settles at its own fair price, so legs may not sum to $1. No ties in NBA.

KXNFLGAME.polymarket: This market will settle to the winner of the <TEAMS> vs <TEAMS> NFL game scheduled for <DATE>. Overtime is included if played. If the game is delayed, postponed, or suspended and not rescheduled to a date within two weeks of the originally scheduled date, the market will settle to the last fair market price.
